scope: Preparation only; no original prereg amendment, production edit, server job or Korea label access
primary_question: Can partial-observation post-training improve incremental OLMoEarth mapping while preserving old-cache and fixed-readout utility?

reference.state_contract: Contextual window embedding using only observations available by the cutoff
reference.observation_contract: Single acquisition embedding; not interchangeable with contextual window state
reference.initial_memory: Existing E0 prefix cache, identical across arms
reference.readout_policy: Frozen D0 in the primary factorial; D1 joint training is separate

inference_information.unknown_publication_time_policy: Acquisition-order replay only; do not claim online publication latency

factorial.forecast_input: Previous state and pre-observation metadata; never the current observation

surprise.calibration: source validation only; report raw and quality/delta-time conditioned residual

metrics.primary: equal-event AP; equal-region AP where events are unavailable
metrics.ci_resampling_unit: event/independent spatial group, not token or seed-by-decoder cell

external.DEN: Temporal label/imagery contract audit required; no assumption of temporal S2 availability
external.Korea: Existing 3-task amendment gates retained; two known readouts plus one unused-in-loss readout proposed; labels remain sealed
